scenes.text: In many creation myths the world begins as water. In Egypt it was Nun, the dark primeval ocean.
Hokusai's Great Wave off Kanagawa, a woodblock print from around 1831, sets fishing boats under a towering sea, with Mount Fuji small behind.
Early Christians used the fish as a sign. In Greek, ichthys reads as an acronym for Jesus Christ, Son of God, Saviour.
In Ravenna, the fifth-century Mausoleum of Galla Placidia has a deep blue vault set with gold stars.
Byzantine artists sealed gold leaf inside glass tiles, so halos glowed in candlelight.

panels.label: The Golden Halo
